name: valve_eli_work_spots_kitchen
note: Black Mesa East's kitchen, the second floor the lift passes (d1_eli_01, 592 under the top landing): a room about 864 by 584, ceiling 200, painted concrete, four fridges and two stoves along the back wall, a third stove, two sinks, shelves, counters, and two prep islands (soupprep, headcrabprep). Its two vortigaunt cooks are in 'wiring' with their scripted_sequences (soupstir, butcher) and the relay that puts the chef's hats on their heads and the ladle and cleaver in their hands (the hat, ladle and cleaver props wait beside them in 'points', parented to the cooks). Also a camera on the cooks for the guard's screens. Faces -y (the lift's gate at y 0; the room runs to +y); anchor on the floor at the middle of the gate. docs/dev/prefabs.md, 'Pieces with their wiring'.
